_comment: Van routing profile for Garmaxxing. The app merges these costing_options
into every Valhalla /route request. Uses the 'truck' costing so height,
weight, length and width restrictions are respected.
MEASURE THE REAL VAN, including roof box, vents and aerials — not the
brochure figure. Units: metres for dimensions, tonnes for weight.
This is a strong safety net, not a guarantee: it is only as good as OSM's
maxheight/maxweight tagging. Always obey the physical signs.
